info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Mortgage Loans Apply-v3-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of mortgage loan applications in bulk. Users can efficiently apply for multiple mortgage loans through one request, streamlining the application process. The endpoint supports businesses and financial institutions aimed at enhancing customer service and operational efficiency in loan processing. Typical consumers include lending platforms and mortgage brokers looking to automate and expedite loan applications for their clients.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a loan application for processing. Ensure that all required information is provided to avoid delays in processing your application.

requestBody.description: The request body for the loan application. It must contain all necessary details required to process a loan request, including personal information, financial data, and loan parameters.

206.description: Partial response indicating the request is processed but not yet complete.
